name: Nails for Breakfast, Tacks for Snacks
author: no joshii
bootlegger: Chaos Hatter: When the Hatter's ability triggers, each Minion and Demon may change character to any Minion or Demon on the script. (A Minion may become the Demon, and the Demon may become a Minion.) If multiple Demons are created this way, deaths that night are arbitrary.
If the Kazali chooses to make a Godfather and the Drunk is not already in play, the Storyteller may change a townsfolk into the Drunk.
